title: Act Two/Inspiration
html:
Overview Approval Inspiration

Inspirations listed on this page can be obtained exclusively in the Shadow-Cursed Lands. For the inspirations which can be earned throughout other Acts of the game as well, refer to the Act One/Inspiration, Anywhere/Multiple Locations section.

Note that certain choices made in Act One may automatically lock the party out of obtaining correlated inspirations in Act Two (and Act Three as well), such as:

  • Killing certain characters (or allowing them to be killed), such as Alfira, Arabella and / or Minthara
  • Allowing the tiefling refugees to be expelled from the Emerald Grove
  • Raiding the Emerald Grove with the goblins
Anywhere/ Multiple locations
Inspiration XP Background Party member/ Hireling NPC/ Location/ Item In-game description and conditions (if any)
Exploration of the Shadow-Cursed Lands
⁠Embracing the Environment 50  Outlander  Karlach,
 Halsin,
 Eldra Luthrinn,
 Sina'zith 		– Survive two rounds of the shadow curse.
  • The inspiration is given at the start of the third turn, if the character feeling the curse effect is still alive and not downed. It does not need to be the Outlander character affected.
⁠I Ain't Afraid of No Shadows 60  Outlander  Karlach,
 Halsin,
 Eldra Luthrinn,
 Sina'zith 		– Traverse through the Shadow-Cursed Lands to Last Light Inn and Moonrise Towers without using a Moonlantern.
  • The party can fail this by accident, as Moonrise Towers are surrounded with streetlight Moonlanterns. To avoid this, enter the Moonrise Tower area from the side route, jumping a broken bridge near Reithwin Tollhouse.
⁠No Cursed Stone Left Unturned 60  Outlander  Karlach,
 Halsin,
 Eldra Luthrinn,
 Sina'zith 		– Explore each key area of the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
  • The party must cross the borders of the Ruined Battlefield, Reithwin Town, the Last Light Inn, and reach the Gauntlet of Shar. The inspiration is given upon entering the last of all four locations, regardless of the order.
Combat
⁠Bumps in the Dark 60  Outlander  Karlach,
 Halsin,
 Eldra Luthrinn,
 Sina'zith 		– Conquer three combat encounters in the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
⁠Masterful Execution 75  Soldier  Lae'zel,  Varanna Sunblossom – Kill any of the bosses in and around the Shadow-Cursed Lands in a single round of combat.
  • Jaheira, if turned hostile and defeated, also counts to obtain this inspiration.
Dialogues
⁠Alley Cats 60  Urchin  Maddala Deadeye  His Majesty,  Steelclaw Meet both the lordly cat and the tadpole-hunting cat.
  • Must talk to both with Speak with Animals, regardless of the order. The Dark Urge killing Steelclaw does not lock the party out of the inspiration.
⁠Fly-Swatter 50  Haunted One  Dark Urge  Dolly Thrice Kill the trickster pixie.
  • The player character may choose to stow the Moonlantern at the ambush site and start the dialogue with Dolly Thrice later by dropping the lantern and picking it up again.
  • Also, the inspiration is automatically granted if the Dark Urge sides with the cultists' convoy and reaches Moonrise Towers with them.
⁠Morally Grey 75  Charlatan  Astarion,  Kree Derryck  Isobel,  Nightsong
⁠Last Light Inn, ⁠Shadowfell 		Betray the trust of Moonrise or Lastlight.
  • The party must allow Marcus to kidnap Isobel, but then free the Nightsong. OR, prevent Marcus from kidnapping Isobel and then let Balthazar transport the Nightsong to Moonrise.
⁠Thorm Family Secrets 60  Sage  Gale,
 Sir Fuzzalump 		⁠Moonrise Towers, ⁠Reithwin Town, ⁠Last Light Inn Discover the fate of Ketheric's family members.
  • Requires interacting with Ketheric, Isobel, Gerringothe Thorm, Malus Thorm, and Thisobald Thorm. The order is irrelevant.
Items
⁠Special Iced Arsenic... Brew? 60  Guild Artisan  Jacelyn  Corpse Rose

⁠Outside barn

Craft some Brewed-Up Bellyglummer.
  • The poison can be actually crafted anywhere, if the party has found the stash and extracted the ingredient, even without reading the brewer's notes.
⁠Notes of an Amateur 60  Criminal  Ver'yll Wenkiir  Corpse Rose

⁠Outside barn

Craft some Brewed-Up Bellyglummer.
  • The poison can be actually crafted anywhere, if the party has found the stash and extracted the ingredient, even without reading the brewer's notes.
Campsite
Inspiration XP Background Party member/ Hireling NPC/ Location/ Item In-game description and conditions (if any)
⁠Nobleborn as Below, so Above 60  Noble  Kerz  Minthara Recruit Minthara.
  • Granted after talking with Minthara in the camp for the first time after escorting her from Moonrise.
⁠Patrician of the Grove 60  Noble  Minthara,  Kerz  Halsin Recruit Halsin.
  • Granted after helping Halsin rescue Thaniel from Shadowfell and talking to Halsin in the camp.
⁠Realities of War 50  Soldier  Lae'zel,  Jaheira,  Varanna Sunblossom  Arabella Tell Arabella what happened to her parents.[See: Bugs]
  • Only available if the player character allows Arabella to stay in the camp temporarily.
⁠Sleeping in the Dark 50  Outlander  Karlach,
 Halsin,
 Eldra Luthrinn,
 Sina'zith 		– Take a full Long Rest in the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
  • This is only awarded for the first time resting in a camp located in the actually dangerous area.
  • Campsites in places devoid of Shadow Curse like Last Light Inn, Moonrise Towers, or the Gauntlet of Shar,[1] do not count.
Shadow-Cursed Lands
Inspiration XP Background Party member/ Hireling NPC/ Location/ Item In-game description and conditions (if any)
Ruined Battlefield
⁠Corrupted Beyond Recognition 50  Sage  Gale,
 Sir Fuzzalump 		 Dead Druid's Journal Find and read the dead druid's journal about how the shadow curse came to be.
  • The inspiration is given regardless of whether the concurrent passive Nature check succeeds.
⁠Let Sleeping Dogs Lie 50  Acolyte  Shadowheart,  Zenith Feur'sel  He Who Was Prevent He Who Was from completing his task.
  • Either grant Madeline forgiveness or make the Shadar-Kai stab himself multiple times.
⁠No Rest for the Wicked 50  Acolyte  Shadowheart,  Zenith Feur'sel  He Who Was Assist He Who Was in his task.
  • Choose to punish Madeline as the Shadar-Kai wants, but not too severely.
⁠Not Another Soul 50  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton  Lassandra,  Meygan,  Karrow Keep all Harpers alive during the ambush with the Shadows.
  • None of the Harpers must be killed by the shadows or be consumed by the Shadow Curse. The most troublesome one is Karrow who often starts chasing the shadows afar from the light sources.
⁠Saving the Prodigious 50  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton  Rolan Save Rolan from the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
  • Only takes place if Rolan was convinced to stay in the Emerald Grove in Act One, and survived the goblins' raid if it occured.
Dealing with cultists' convoy
⁠Centennial Rivalries 50  Soldier  Lae'zel,  Varanna Sunblossom  Kar'niss,  Harper Branthos Complete the Harper ambush.
  • This inspiration is granted only if the fight occured, but regardless of how the party approaches the ambush site, and of which side they pick eventually.
⁠Forcing Responsibility 50  Haunted One  Dark Urge  Gronag Demand that the goblin fetch his bone.
  • First stop goblin from sending the Hyena to fetch, then pass any ability check to make him do it instead.
⁠Plucking the Lyre's Web 50  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong  Spider's Lyre Play the Spider's Lyre to attract the drider.
  • The party must play the lyre obtained or looted from Nere or from Minthara to summon Kar'niss. Granted regardless of passing the Performance skill check.
⁠Shiny Trinkets and Baubles 50  Criminal  Ver'yll Wenkiir  Moonlantern Take the drider's Moonlantern.
  • Granted whichever way the lantern is obtained.
⁠Trust and a Little Pixie Dust 50  Guild Artisan  Jacelyn Moonlantern Investigate the Moonlantern and find its power source.
  • The options to inspect the Moonlantern appear only when obtaining it from Kar'niss at the Harpers' ambush site.
House in Deep Shadows
⁠Child at Heart 50  Urchin  Maddala Deadeye  Oliver Play both games of hide and seek with Oliver.
  • This inspiration is given for participating in both rounds, winning is not necessary.
⁠Child's Play 50  Outlander  Karlach,
 Eldra Luthrinn,
 Sina'zith 		 Oliver Beat Oliver at hide and seek without alerting the shadow creatures.
  • This inspiration is given for winning in both rounds.
Last Light Inn
Inspiration XP Background Party member/ Hireling NPC/ Location/ Item In-game description and conditions (if any)
General
⁠Absolute Devastation 75  Soldier  Lae'zel,  Varanna Sunblossom – Destroy Last Light.
  • The party must destroy the lunar protective shield around the Last Light Inn, either killing or knocking out Isobel, or killing the Nightsong in Shadowfell.
Dealing with Jaheira
⁠Forced Retirement 75  Haunted One  Dark Urge  Jaheira End Jaheira's career permanently by killing her.
  • If this inspiration is not earned in Act Two, it can be earned as well in Act Three in Bhaal Temple.
⁠From One Hero to Another 50  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton  Jaheira Meet Jaheira and drink the wine she offers.[See: Bugs]
⁠Living Legend 50  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong  Jaheira Accept Jaheira's invitation to talk.
Dealing with Marcus and Isobel
⁠Always Trust a Dishonest Person 50  Charlatan  Astarion,  Kree Derryck  Jaheira
 Marcus 		Expose Marcus to the Harpers.
  • Only available if the Emerald Grove was raided, or if the tieflings were expelled from it. Otherwise, Marcus is not in the inn when the party comes.
⁠An Absolute Douceur 60  Criminal  Ver'yll Wenkiir ⁠Isobel's Bedroom Accept the Absolute's promise of gifts.
  • Granted after the player character agrees to help Marcus kidnap Isobel.
⁠Long-Awaited Reunion 75  Criminal  Ver'yll Wenkiir ⁠Isobel's Bedroom Hand Isobel over to Ketheric Thorm.
  • Isobel must be knocked out in the fight, but survive it.
⁠Lunar Eclipse 75  Haunted One  Dark Urge ⁠Isobel's Bedroom Kill the protector of Last Light.
⁠Meeting of Fates 60  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton ⁠Isobel's Bedroom Side with either Isobel or Marcus during the confrontation in Last Light.
⁠Moonweaver's Prayer 50  Acolyte  Shadowheart,  Zenith Feur'sel ⁠Isobel's Bedroom Witness Isobel's ritual to keep up the protection of Last Light.
⁠Shield of the Moon 50  Soldier  Lae'zel,  Varanna Sunblossom ⁠Isobel's Bedroom Obtain Selûne's blessing from Isobel.
⁠Tadpole Solidarity 50  Charlatan  Astarion,  Kree Derryck ⁠Isobel's Bedroom Go along with Marcus' plan.
  • Granted only if Marcus vouches for the party at the entrance, and is not exposed to Jaheira. Thus, obtainable only if the tieflings from the Emerald Grove did not survive.
Dealing with Raphael[2] and Mol
⁠Helping the Little Guy 50  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton ⁠Side Hall Help Mol win the game of lanceboard.
  • This inspiration is granted if using any available method, including rigging the board.
⁠Orphan Camaraderie 50  Urchin  Maddala Deadeye ⁠Side Hall Help Mol win the game of lanceboard.
  • This inspiration is granted if using any available method, including rigging the board.
⁠Shuffling the Board 50  Charlatan  Astarion,  Kree Derryck ⁠Side Hall Rig the game of lanceboard.
  • This one is given only if a Sleight of Hand option is successfully used.
⁠Theskan Tactician 50  Sage  Gale,
 Sir Fuzzalump 		⁠Side Hall Help Mol win the game of lanceboard.
  • This inspiration is granted if using any available method, including rigging the board.
Dealing with Art Cullagh
⁠Favour for a Favour 60  Noble  Minthara,  Kerz ⁠Dormitories Wake Art for Counsellor Florrick and the Flaming Fist.
⁠Strings of Fate 60  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong ⁠Dormitories Bring Art his lute.
⁠Waking the Sleeper 60  Sage  Gale,
 Sir Fuzzalump 		⁠Dormitories Wake Art from his catatonic slumber.
The Harper's funeral[3]
⁠Memento Mori 50  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong  Meygan ⁠Courtyard Witness Yonas' funeral.
⁠Tragic Love 50  Acolyte  Shadowheart,  Zenith Feur'sel  Meygan ⁠Courtyard Offer condolences to Meygan.
Other interactions with NPCs
⁠A Smile Better Suits... 50  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton  Alfira
⁠Main Hall 		Offer a hopeful response to Alfira's inquiry.
  • When talking to Alfira for the first time in Last Light, answer to her question "How do you keep going?" with any available line except "I don't complain constantly." Also, don't mention other tieflings being tortured in Moonrise.
⁠Grove Keeper's Keeper 60  Outlander  Karlach,
 Eldra Luthrinn,
 Sina'zith 		 Halsin ⁠River beach Protect Halsin's portal while he saves the spirit of the land.
⁠Hellish Armaments 60  Guild Artisan  Jacelyn  Dammon ⁠Stables Obtain a piece of infernal equipment from Dammon.
  • Give Dammon a piece of Infernal Iron to make something. Reworking Devilfoil Masks does not count.
⁠In the Palm of My Hand 50  Guild Artisan  Jacelyn  Barcus Wroot ⁠Side Hall Acquire the Brilliant Retort from Barcus.
  • This is the reward for completing the quest Rescue Wulbren.
⁠Noble Feline 50  Noble  Minthara,  Kerz  His Majesty ⁠Main Hall Speak with the lordly cat at Last Light.
  • Granted only if using Speak with Animals.
Reithwin Town
Inspiration XP Background Party member/ Hireling NPC/ Location/ Item In-game description and conditions (if any)
General
⁠Familicide 60  Soldier  Lae'zel,  Varanna Sunblossom  Gerringothe,  Malus, and  Thisobald Thorm Kill all members of the Thorm family.
  • Ketheric and Isobel are not counted to earn this.
⁠Power Corrupts 60  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton  Gerringothe,  Malus, and  Thisobald Thorm Defeat a major figure in the corrupted town.
  • Killing any one of these grants the inspiration.
⁠Power Corrupts... Absolutely 75  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton  Gerringothe,  Malus, and  Thisobald Thorm Defeat all of the major figures in the corrupted town.
  • This inspiration is granted after killing all three, regardless of the order.
⁠The Best Offence is Virtually Nonsense 60  Soldier  Lae'zel,  Varanna Sunblossom  Gerringothe,  Malus, and  Thisobald Thorm Defeat a member of the Thorm family without drawing steel.
  • Granted if any of these is killed through passing a series of ability checks in the dialogue.
⁠Town of Shadows 60  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong  Gerringothe,  Malus, and  Thisobald Thorm
the mason 		Find out the fate of each of the major characters in the town: the brewer, the surgeon, the toll collector and the mason.
  • The order is irrelevant. To collect information on the mason, read the plaque under the "Odd Looking Bones" in the Mason's Guild hall.
Mason's Guild
⁠Tragedy in Masonry 60  Guild Artisan  Jacelyn ⁠Odd Looking Bones Discover the fate of the mason.
  • Read the plaque under the pile of bones in the Mason's Guild hall. Earned only on the first time you read the plaque.
Reithwin Tollhouse
⁠Confiscated Works 60  Guild Artisan  Jacelyn  Fireheart Acquire a magical item from the toll collector's confiscation chest.
  • Loot the necklace from the chest in the "Seized Inventory" room.
⁠Personal Payroll 60  Criminal  Ver'yll Wenkiir ⁠Gerringothe's safe Discover the Toll Collector's personal hoard.
  • The safe at X: -113 Y: -84 requires passing a  DC 16 Strength Check or using Knock spell to open.
⁠Takes One to Know One 60  Charlatan  Astarion,  Kree Derryck  Grim Visage x6 Expose the true form of the toll collector by removing all her gold armour.
  • Engage in a fight with Gerringothe and kill all her minions. Defeating each one removes a part of her armour.
⁠Taxes? Never Heard of 'Em 50  Noble  Minthara,  Kerz  Gerringothe Thorm Do not give any gold to the toll collector.
  • This includes single coins tossed to her throughout the dialogue. Thus, can be earned only through fighting her.
Sharran Sanctuary and the town square
⁠Tales of Yore 60  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong – Piece the scriptures together correctly and reveal the secret in the town square.
  • Interact the three plaques on the sides of the monument on the city square.[4]
⁠Tenets of Loss 60  Sage  Gale,
 Sir Fuzzalump 		– Open the way into the Sharran Sanctuary.
  • Interact the three plaques on the sides of the monument on the city square.[4]
⁠A Dark Edge 60  Criminal  Ver'yll Wenkiir  Ritual Dagger of Shar Take Shar's dagger from the ritual pedestal.
  • The way to the pedestal opens after passing the three checks on Shar's statues. Taking the dagger prompts a fight with three undead Sentinels.
⁠Honing the Darkness 60  Acolyte  Shadowheart,  Zenith Feur'sel ⁠Statues of Shar Pass all of Shar's tests in the middle of the cursed town.
  • Pass  DC 14 Saving Throw on Charisma, Intelligence and Wisdom (not necessary done by the same party member).
⁠Partaking in Local Customs 60  Sage  Gale,
 Sir Fuzzalump 		⁠Statues of Shar Perform the ritual in the Sharran Sanctuary.
  • Pass  DC 10 Religion Check on the altar to Shar in the hidden room and sacrifice your blood.
⁠Ruthless Craftsmanship 60  Guild Artisan  Jacelyn  Ritual Dagger of Shar Take Shar's ceremonial dagger.
  • The way to the pedestal opens after passing the three checks on Shar's statues. Taking the dagger prompts a fight with three undead Sentinels.
⁠A Tale of Two Souls 60  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong  Oliver Complete the saga of Art, Halsin and the spirit of the land.
  • Granted after the player character convinces Oliver to reunite with Thaniel.
⁠It Came From Shadows 60  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong  Oliver Discover the source of the Shadow Curse.
  • Granted after the party defeat Oliver and his "family" in the town square.
House of Healing
⁠An Apple a Day Keeps the Scalpel Away 60  Soldier  Lae'zel,
 Jaheira,  Varanna Sunblossom 		 Malus Thorm Defeat the Surgeon without being operated upon.
  • Get Malus killed through the dilogue options
  • OR, if a combat starts, don't allow him to use his nurses' tools on any party member.
⁠Did My Homework 60  Acolyte  Shadowheart,  Zenith Feur'sel  Malus Thorm Recite Shar's dogma to the surgeon.
  • Pass a  DC 14 Religion Check and use the specific dialogue line. Not available for Shadowheart, if she is the one interacting with Malus.
⁠Inhumane Trials 60  Guild Artisan  Jacelyn  Malus Thorm Witness a horrid operation in the cursed house of healing.
  • "Horrid operation" refers to the nurses "operating" upon each other or upon Malus Thorm.
⁠Right Tool for the Job 60  Criminal  Ver'yll Wenkiir  Artificial Leech,  Bonesaw,  Syringe,  Trepan Obtain all 4 variants of the nurses' tools.
  • The tools can be looted after the nurses are dead, and cannot be pickpocketed from them. Only nurses which assist Malus initially have the enhanced tools (Anya, Hunna, Geanne, and Vanessa).
⁠Under the Knife 60  Haunted One  Dark Urge  Malus Thorm Kill the surgeon using his own servile nurses.
  • Convince Malus to become a subject for the nurses to hone their medicinal skill.
Graveyard and Morgue
⁠Blessed's Final Rest 60  Acolyte  Shadowheart,  Zenith Feur'sel  Olam's Journal

⁠Morgue workshop

Find the aasimar's journal.
⁠Greatness Thrust Upon Them 60  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton  Arabella

⁠Graveyard

Find, save and bring Arabella to camp.
  • Available only if Arabella survived the events of Act One. The party must agree to shelter her in the camp. Fighting the shadows she entangles is not necessary.
⁠Hippocratic No More 60  Sage  Gale,
 Sir Fuzzalump 		 Surgeon's Research Notes

⁠Morgue lab

Find the surgeon's research notes.
⁠Snuffed Spark 60  Sage  Gale,
 Sir Fuzzalump 		 Olam's Journal

⁠Morgue workshop

Find the dead aasimar's journal.
The Waning Moon
⁠A Story You Won't Believe 60  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong  Thisobald Thorm Pass all Performance checks when telling a tall tale to the brewer.
  • Thisobald demands a story twice. The Performance checks have DC from 16 to 21 (the full list is on his page).
⁠I've Had Worse 60  Outlander  Karlach,
 Halsin,
 Eldra Luthrinn,
 Sina'zith 		 Thisobald Thorm Successfully drink and resist the negative effects of the brewer's concoction.
  • After each drink the interacting character makes a passive  Constitution Saving Throw, with DC 14, then DC 16. The inspiration is granted for any single success, even if the other rolls fail.
⁠Lack of Moderation is Key 60  Haunted One  Dark Urge  Thisobald Thorm Kill the brewer with his own brew.
  • Make Thisobald drink three steins by any means possible, without making him hostile. This requires passing ability checks to drink/mime drinking and to amuse him in three rounds in a row.
⁠Safety-Averse Quaffing 60  Guild Artisan  Jacelyn  Thisobald Thorm Drink at least 1 of the brewer's steins.
  • Granted on the first choosing the option to drink, regardless of the Constitution saving throw result.
⁠Tricks of the Trade 60  Charlatan  Astarion,  Kree Derryck  Thisobald Thorm Successfully pretend to drink from the steins of ale.
  • There are three Sleight of Hand checks with DC raising from 18 to 21 (Rogues have lower DCs on each). The inspiration is granted for any single success, even if the other rolls fail.
Moonrise Towers
Inspiration XP Background Party member/ Hireling NPC/ Location/ Item In-game description and conditions (if any)
Outside territory
⁠Odd Entourage 50  Noble  Kerz  Kar'niss Complete the drider escort to Moonrise
  • Granted once the cutscene with the guards at the entrance ends.
⁠Swimming with the Shadows 60  Haunted One  Dark Urge  Acolyte Marls

⁠Moonrise Docks

Force the Zhent smuggler to jump off the docks.
  • Convince Marls to let you inspect the cargo. When he feels the tadpoles, suggest he washes them off.
⁠Mutual Respect 50  Outlander  Karlach,
 Halsin,
 Eldra Luthrinn,
 Sina'zith 		 Steelclaw

⁠Balcony behind Sanguine lab

Meet Steelclaw the tadpole-hunting cat.
  • Granted only if using Speak with Animals. The Dark Urge killing Steelclaw does not lock the party out of the inspiration?
Main Floor - Lobby and Sanguine Laboratory
⁠Blood, Sweat, and the Other Thing 50  Guild Artisan  Jacelyn  Araj Oblodra Give your blood to Araj Oblodra.
⁠Notched Armour 50  Soldier  Lae'zel,  Varanna Sunblossom  Lann Tarv Show off your prowess to the bugbear merchant.
  • Must pass any of available ability checks when Lann asks for a proof. The full list of possible options is on his page.
⁠Uncommon Recognition 50  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton  Lann Tarv Relate your feats to the bugbear merchant.
  • Must pass any of available ability checks when Lann asks for a proof. The full list of possible options is on his page.
⁠War Profiteer 50  Criminal  Ver'yll Wenkiir  Roah Moonglow Find Roah in Moonrise and trade with her.
  • Available only if Roah survived the events of Act One.
Main floor - Throne room
⁠Devastation of the Absolute 75  Soldier  Lae'zel,  Varanna Sunblossom – Complete the assault on Moonrise.
  • Before going to the rooftop or after return from the MFC? Speak to Jaheira?
⁠A Velvet Glove 50  Noble  Kerz  Fezzerk,  Sazza, or  Darra Spare the goblins.
⁠An Iron Fist 50  Noble  Kerz  Fezzerk,  Sazza, or  Darra Execute the goblins.
⁠Newly Downtrodden 50  Urchin  Maddala Deadeye  Fezzerk,  Sazza, or  Darra Spare the goblins from Ketheric's wrath.
⁠Too Easy 50  Haunted One  Dark Urge  Fezzerk,  Sazza, or  Darra Execute the useless goblins.
Main floor - Mess Hall and Kitchen
⁠A Different Kind of Muse 50  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong ⁠Cracked wall Connect to the strange consciousness in Moonrise Towers.
  • Granted regardless of whether the character successfully resisted to being dragged down.
⁠They're in the Walls! 50  Sage  Gale,
 Sir Fuzzalump 		⁠Cracked wall Discover what the 'meat sound' is.
  • Granted regardless of whether the character successfully resisted to being dragged down.
  • Despite the party can learn about the 'meat sound' only from Mig, the inspiration is granted without speaking to her as well.
⁠Danse Macabre 50  Entertainer  Brinna Brightsong  Linsella,  'Barnabus' Make the gnolls stay under the influence of their master.
⁠Gone Feral 50  Urchin  Maddala Deadeye  Linsella,  'Barnabus' Free the mind-controlled gnolls from their master.
⁠No Strings to Hold Them Back 50  Folk Hero  Wyll,  Danton  Linsella,  'Barnabus' Release the gnolls from their enslavement.
⁠Pied Piper 50  Charlatan  Astarion,  Kree Derryck  Linsella,  'Barnabus' Successfully influence the gnolls, either to break free or continue being subservient.
  • Granted regardless of the choice made by the player character.
⁠Who Let the Gnolls Out 60  Haunted One  Dark Urge  Linsella,  'Barnabus' Release the gnolls from their leashes.
First floor - General
⁠Enter Nostalgia 60  Criminal  Ver'yll Wenkiir ⁠Ketheric's chambers, ⁠Isobel's room Trespass into Ketheric and Isobel's respective rooms.
  • If exploring the room before witnessing Ketheric's trial, it is not yet guarded by Squire.
⁠Never Liked Stairs 60  Outlander  Karlach,
 Halsin,
 Eldra Luthrinn,
 Sina'zith 		⁠Ketheric's chambers, ⁠Isobel's room, OR ⁠Balthazar's chambers Enter a restricted area in Moonrise Towers from the outside.
  • Climb the roots to the east from the main entrance, then reach the balcony by jumping to the scaffolds, and lockpick any of the doors. Must be the first time you enter any of the restricted rooms.
  • Entering Isobel's room from the rafters inside does not count.
First floor - Talking to Z'rell
⁠Clear Conscience 50  Charlatan  Astarion,  Kree Derryck  Z'rell Successfully lie to Z'rell about the fate of the goblins.

Bugs

  • There are two more campsite inspirational events concerning Arabella. Both should be granted for lying to her about the fate of her parents. However, the trigger for these inspiration events is a specific unreachable scene with Withers and Arabella, and thus, these inspiration points cannot be earned in the current game version (4.1.17209685). These are as following:
    • Little White Lies ( Charlatan background)
    • War is No Place for a Child ( Soldier background)
  • Two more inspirations concerning the player character's decision to drink or not Jaheira's spiked wine do not trigger as of game version 4.1.17209685. These are as following:
    • Not My First Time ( Charlatan background) - for passing Constitution check to lie about the tadpole effects, after the player character discerned the truth serum in the wine but still drank it
    • Wary of Strangers ( Urchin background) - for refusing to drink the wine at all (regardless of knowing whether it is spiked)
